company.name: Spring
company.shortDescription: Spring is the link between creators and commerce. Innovative tools and services empower creators to launch products while selling on social.
company.description: Spring (formerly Teespring) provides creators with an end-to-end solution to build a successful commerce business, as well as building their brand. Creators can design and sell digital and physical products on Spring. They can utilize the platform’s powerful integrations with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch, Discord and Streamlabs allowing them to sell on social. Spring also handles order production, shipping, and customer service so users can focus on growing their brand.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,850,000 to $92,952,987, a 24.14x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 30 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 8 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Baked T's, WoFox, Fourthwall.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
